chosen_titles.rationale: Title 21 (Public Officers and Employees) houses the AR ethics regime including the lobbying-disclosure subchapters (Ch. 8 Subch. 4/6) per the AR 2010 prior.
Title 10 (General Assembly) contains legislative-branch lobbying provisions (Ch. 1) parallel to the Title 21 executive-branch regime, per the AR 2010 prior.

notes: AR 2015 index returned 28 titles. Selected Title 21 + Title 10 to mirror the structure validated at AR 2010 (Title 21 Ch. 8 ethics + Title 10 Ch. 1 legislative lobbying).
